name: Inpatient Hospital
description: Acute inpatient care provided by short-term acute care hospitals, paid under the Medicare Inpatient Prospective Payment System using Diagnosis-Related Groups (DRGs). Includes medical and surgical admissions, critical care, and psychiatric units (if distinct).

name: Outpatient Hospital
description: Services furnished by hospital outpatient departments and ambulatory surgical centers (ASCs). Hospital outpatient services paid under OPPS using Ambulatory Payment Classifications (APCs); ASCs paid under a separate ASC fee schedule.

name: Physician/Professional Services
description: Services furnished by physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and other eligible professionals. Paid under the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule using RBRVS-based relative value units (RVUs) multiplied by a conversion factor.
innovationModels: Value in Opioid Use Disorder Treatment

name: Skilled Nursing Facility
description: Post-acute inpatient care provided by skilled nursing facilities for Medicare beneficiaries following a qualifying hospital stay of 3+ days. Paid under the SNF PPS using the Patient Driven Payment Model (PDPM) based on clinical characteristics.

name: Home Health
description: Skilled nursing, therapy, and aide services provided in the home for homebound Medicare beneficiaries. Paid under the Home Health PPS using the Patient-Driven Groupings Model (PDGM), which classifies 30-day periods by clinical characteristics and functional impairment.

name: Hospice
description: Palliative care and support services for terminally ill Medicare beneficiaries with a life expectancy of 6 months or less. Paid on a per-diem basis with four levels of care: routine home care, continuous home care, inpatient respite, and general inpatient care.

name: Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility
description: Intensive inpatient rehabilitation services for patients requiring multi-disciplinary team rehabilitation (e.g., stroke, joint replacement). Paid under the IRF PPS using Case-Mix Groups (CMGs) based on patient clinical characteristics and functional status.

name: End-Stage Renal Disease
description: Dialysis services for Medicare beneficiaries with ESRD. Paid under the ESRD PPS as a bundled per-treatment payment covering dialysis, labs, drugs, and supplies. Home dialysis is encouraged through expanded coverage and a transitional add-on payment.

name: Oncology
description: Cancer diagnosis, treatment, and management services including chemotherapy administration, radiation, surgical oncology, and associated supportive care. Paid primarily under the Physician Fee Schedule with drug payments under buy-and-bill (Part B drugs) or Part D.

name: Behavioral Health
description: Mental health and substance use disorder (SUD) services including psychiatric evaluation, psychotherapy, medication management, and community mental health services. Paid under the Physician Fee Schedule. Mental Health Parity applies to Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care.
